experiment: C6 exploratory two-level hierarchical recursive Canaria recompilation

procedure.stage1_local: fit C1..C4 separately to a0->a1, a1->a2, a2->a3, a3->a4
procedure.stage2_level1_pairs: jointly adapt [C1,C2] to original a0->a2 and [C3,C4] to original a2->a4, then freeze each pair
procedure.stage3_level1_recursive: fit C12 only to frozen pair12 outputs and C34 only to frozen pair34 outputs; original pair targets forbidden for recursive fits

stage4_level2_conditions.hierarchical_frozen: compose C12->C34 with no original-full-span adaptation, freeze, then fit C1234 only to hierarchy outputs
stage4_level2_conditions.hierarchical_joint: jointly adapt C12+C34 to original a0->a4, freeze, then fit C1234 only to adapted hierarchy outputs
stage4_level2_conditions.single_level_recursive: start from the four separately fitted locals, jointly adapt all four to original a0->a4, freeze, then fit matched C1234 only to four-local cluster outputs
stage4_level2_conditions.direct_original_single: fit matched C1234 directly to original a0->a4

validation_endpoints: level1 C12 and C34 NMSE vs their original pair spans
pre-final hierarchy NMSE vs original full span
final C1234 NMSE vs its immediate recursive teacher
final C1234 NMSE vs original full-span teacher
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory only. No held-out test evaluation. Positive results can justify fresh confirmatory arbitrary-depth/bounded-error testing, but do not establish universal or unlimited recursive depth.
